verdicts.reason: A has a sensible left-to-right banner flow: brand and headline on the left, details and a clear RSVP CTA in the middle, phone on the right. Its flaws: the headline crowds the left edge, the middle column is jammed against the bottom edge with fine print squeezed under the CTA, the phone is cropped at the right edge, and the placeholder box sits awkwardly next to it. B is broken: the RSVP CTA has shrunk to a tiny pill lost in the badge row, the subhead is wedged as a narrow ragged column, 'Saturday 21 / June' breaks awkwardly, the placeholder box has been blown up huge, and the legal text is illegible, so the reading order is jumbled.
